_about: PDRN hero and key figures, 2026-09-24, from the design critique: the hero subtitle becomes the template's one-line promise with no number (it repeated the figure directly below it, and its length ran onto the busy helix at 2.85:1 contrast); key figure 2's subheading now reads as PDRN's improvement, not retinol's change; overlay 25 -> 50: measured at the 98th-percentile background pixel under each text line, 35% left the desktop subtitle at 3.56:1 and the mobile eyebrow at 3.33:1, 45% at 4.49 and 4.24 (small text needs 4.5:1). A stopgap until the banner is recomposed. Owns hero/p1/content and stats/s2/subheading.

values.en:
PDRN: Salmon DNA Skincare

A salmon-derived polynucleotide (INCI: Sodium DNA), shown in a controlled trial to soften the look of crow's feet.
values.de:
PDRN: Hautpflege mit Lachs-DNA

Ein Polynukleotid aus Lachs-DNA (INCI: Sodium DNA), das in einer kontrollierten Studie das Erscheinungsbild von Krähenfüßen milderte.
values.nl:
PDRN: huidverzorging met zalm-DNA

Een polynucleotide uit zalm-DNA (INCI: Sodium DNA) dat in een gecontroleerde studie de aanblik van kraaienpootjes verzachtte.
values.fr:
PDRN : les soins à l'ADN de saumon

Un polynucléotide issu de l'ADN de saumon (INCI : Sodium DNA), qui a atténué l'apparence des pattes-d'oie dans un essai contrôlé.
values.es:
PDRN: cuidado de la piel con ADN de salmón

Un polinucleótido derivado del ADN de salmón (INCI: Sodium DNA) que suavizó el aspecto de las patas de gallo en un ensayo controlado.
values.it:
PDRN: skincare al DNA di salmone

Un polinucleotide derivato dal DNA di salmone (INCI: Sodium DNA) che ha attenuato l'aspetto delle zampe di gallina in uno studio controllato.
